kjv: as in the provocation, [and] as [in] the day of temptation in the wilderness
mine: as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness
note: Meribah ("quarrel") and Massah ("testing") are the place names of Ex 17:7; the KJV translates them (following the LXX, quoted in Heb 3:8), so the historical allusion is hidden.
